learning_outcomes.text: To understand the microstructure and phase states of materials.
Recognizes, classifies and learns internal structures of steels and cast irons.
To understand the kinetic and thermal processes applied to materials.
To learn the causes and consequences of the environmental effects to which the materials are exposed.
To learn the electrical and magnetic properties of materials.

syllabus_topics: Phase transitions for Fe-Fe3C and Fe-C phase diagram.
Phase transitions for Fe-Fe3C and Fe-C phase diagram (continued). Technical applications.
Heat treatment. Heat treatment of steels. Temperature-time diagrams.
Tempering methods. Homogenizing. Grain growth. Stress relief.
Hardening. Cooling effects. Austenitic transformations. Pearlite transformation. Bainite transformation. Martensite transformation.
TTT diagrams. CCT diagrams. IT diagrams. Applications.
Hardenability. Quenching. Quenching methods. Applications. Hardening experiments. Jominy test. Quenching and tempering. Applications.
Surface hardening methods. Carburizing. Carburizing types. Applications.
Standards. TS, EN, AISI standards for steels, cast irons, nonferrous materials. Examples.
